function.name: uv_index_get_future
function.description: Retrieve UV index data for a specified location and date. Unlike rainfall_prediction, which retrieves rainfall data, this retrieves UV index data.

location.description: The location to retrieve the UV index for.

date.description: The date for the UV index, in the format mm-dd-yyyy.

function.name: rainfall_prediction
function.description: Retrieve rainfall data for a specified location and date. Unlike uv_index_get_future, which retrieves UV index data, this retrieves rainfall data.

location.description: The location to retrieve the rainfall prediction for.

date.description: The date for the rainfall prediction, in the format mm/dd/yyyy.'

function.name: snowfall_prediction
function.description: Retrieve snowfall data for a specified location and date. Unlike uv_index_get_future, which retrieves UV index data, this retrieves snowfall data.

location.description: The location to retrieve the snowfall prediction for.

date.description: The date for the snowfall prediction, in the format mm-dd-yyyy.
